{{Quote|We don't know how many Star Destroyers are still in service. Moff Harlov Jarnek has blockaded Spirador. Hundreds of planets still need our help.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLoLS">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>}}
The '''Spirador system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spirador]] which was chosen as the sector capital by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlov Jarnek]].
